builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Yasuo: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile melee critical fighter who uses enemy units as dash routes, builds a knockup and punishes airborne targets. Account for kit crit/attack-speed rules and Q cooldown limits. Dash units and airborne setup are real constraints; excess attack speed need not create faster Q forever. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Yasuo: Account for kit crit/attack-speed rules and Q cooldown limits. Dash units and airborne setup are real constraints; excess attack speed need not create faster Q forever.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Flow. Do not treat mana regeneration as Flow recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.

Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.
Full cost 16,550 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.

Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
